comment: KOTOR III (fan) Nar Shaddaa landing pad. Corva, a watcher for the hidden scouts, warns the crew to turn back. Original writing for this fan project.

entries.text: Leave the weapon holstered. Talking is all I came for. You and the courier have been asking about routes past the charts.
Corva. I serve a lord with a very long memory. My name will not matter to you for much longer than this conversation.
Go back to Telos. Give the recording to the station archive and forget the coordinates. What waits beyond the charts reaches far, and it has already noticed you.
Then my errand here is finished. When your signals start coming back unanswered, remember that someone offered you the way home first.
Then you choose it with open eyes. I give one warning. My lord gives none.

replies.text: Say what you came to say.
And what does your lord want from us?
Consider us warned. We are still going.
